title: Why Is the Sky Blue?
snippet: Blue light is scattered more than the other colors because it travels as shorter, smaller waves. This is why we see a blue sky most of the time.

title: Why is the sky blue?
snippet: A clear cloudless day-time sky is blue because molecules in the air scatter blue light from the Sun more than they scatter red light.
